title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
text: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
text: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

title: Canva releases its first image generation model
text: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.

title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
text: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?

title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
text: Fast, focused, low-cost decisions for any application.

title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
text: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.

title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
text: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
text: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

title: Spotify’s current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
text: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explains why the rise of AI agents could be good news for the music service.

title: Beyond tree cover: mapping the world’s forest types
text: A global map categorizing every 10-meter patch of land on Earth into distinct forest types.

title: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
text: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.

title: Nirva raises $33M for a pendant that only listens to you
text: Nirva will ship its $249 ambient AI pendant by the end of the year.

title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
text: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.

title: Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
text: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees, helping teams research, analyze data, create presentations, and complete complex workflows.

title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
text: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.

title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock
text: The social media giant is planning a new stock strategy to help power its broad investments in AI models and services.

title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
text: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
text: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during its Q3 earnings call. The AI app now has over 10M users.
